text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Turn it up~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
C'mon everybody! Clap your hands! 
Put 'em up high and clap your hands!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
When you smile ♪ party time! 
♪ Double the fun!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
And・here・it・comes~? BAM, Heli-spin!
Dancing on air with Ojou!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: (—What is this...?)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: (The committee members... Are they rehearsing...?)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hands up! Hands up! C'mon everybody!

text_block_list.name: Committee Uma Musume A
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Can't hear you! Louder! C'mon, Bam-chan!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Next up! You ready? C'mon, Zeph-chi~!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yeah♪ Yeah♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Keep it up! That's the vibe! Let's go— everybody!

text_block_list.name: Committee Members
text_block_list.text: YEAH! YEAH!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Aight—! Keep hands up, then! 
Spin and jump! Jump and spin!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
When you smile, happy time! 
Sing along!

text_block_list.name: Committee Members
text_block_list.text: Sun always shines right by your side♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Don't wanna forget it? Keep chatter flowing, 
get the person next to you hyped too!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Round and round! Dance・dance・dance~~! Whoo~~~~!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Haha~ Incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: (...This is Helios-san's performance.)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
(This sheer energy... 
This was what I lacked...)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ah! Ojoooou—!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Princess Princess Princess! Didja see? Well? 
Doesn't Droite look ultra fun?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
—Yes, indeed. Will these outfits 
be worn for the actual performance?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh, this? Yup! Wanna be Ojou's escort! 
Put this together 'cause I wanna rage with you!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Ojou! If we party together, 
Best Date is totally ours!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Please be my date!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —...Very well.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Please go with—... Wait, huh? Did you say "very well"? 
Yes? OK? For real?!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Helios-san, your enthusiasm and emotion possess the power 
to draw others in. Thus, I have resolved my stance.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —I look forward to our pairing.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: LETS GOOOOO—!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Going on a date with Ojou ♡ 
Lovey-dovey practice ♪ Ehehehehe~♡

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Forgive the delay, Helios-san.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ah, Oj—...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: ...CUTE!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what? So cute?! 
Huh, huh, is that your fit? Whoa!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Yes. As previously mentioned, 
today serves as our dress rehearsal.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, hype!! Wait, blue? That's my color?! 
And flame motif too! Matching set~~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You wanted to match? 
Is this... true love?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
No, nothing of the sort. 
However...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —I shall match passion with passion.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
—! Yeah! Let's party hard! 
Gonna give you the most hype time ever!
